blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives shuffled roughly P200 billion within the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget. This is equivalent to about P80 billion more than what was publicly disclosed by a select committee of ranking lawmakers, a watchdog assessment showed on Thursday. The House hiked 123 budget bill line items by P198.9 billion, with more than half of the additions streamed toward infrastructure, health and healthcare aid programs. The information comes from People’s Budget Coalition Co-convener Adolfo Jose “AJ” Montesa’s technical assessment.
